subject: Post-Summit tally: demo-driven opportunities missing from MQL rollup
messages:
From: Julian Park <julian@cyclist.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Cyclist AI RevOps <revops@cyclist.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 13:22:41 -0800
Subject: Post‑summit numbers — missing demo-scheduler leads

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the booth at the Virtual Dev Summit on Jan 12 — great turnout. Our RevOps team just ran a reconciliation and we’re seeing a significant discrepancy between the leads we captured and the opportunities your post-event rollup is crediting.

Briefly: we have 28 demo conversions tied to the summit (booked through the in-booth demo scheduler). Your report lists 19 opportunities attributed to the summit. RevOps believes nine demo-scheduler signups were not tagged as MQLs in Redwood’s export and therefore didn’t roll into the event-sourced pipeline.

Attached is our export (cyclist_summit_leads.xlsx) with contact emails, HubSpot IDs, and demo timestamps — flagged rows are the nine in question. Can you confirm whether those were excluded because the demo scheduler created contacts with a direct source or because of lead scoring thresholds? We need this reconciled for our internal post-mortem and to distribute sponsorship credits.

Can we get a short reconciliation by EOD Wednesday? If not possible, let’s book a 30-min sync.

Thanks,
Julian Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Cyclist AI

--
Attachment: cyclist_summit_leads.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julian Park <julian@cyclist.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 15:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Post‑summit numbers — missing demo-scheduler leads

Hi Julian — thanks for the export and the clear flags. I’ve looped in Laura (Marketing Ops) and Aditya (AE) to investigate.

Quick context from our side: our standard event attribution looks for either an event form submission (utm_event + form_type=event-form) or a demo scheduler submission where the form creates a lead and assigns source=event. Separately we apply MQL thresholds (lead_score >= 75) for automatic opportunity creation for some partners. It sounds like the demo-scheduler entries you flagged may have landed in HubSpot with source=direct and score under threshold, which would explain the mismatch.

Laura — can you pull the raw export we sent to Cyclist and compare the HubSpot IDs Julian attached vs the event report we generated (I’ve asked ops to attach it when they reply)? If there are leads that meet the event criteria but were missed due to a mapping bug we should: 1) backfill event_source for those contacts, 2) regenerate the event rollup, and 3) manually credit any closed/won deals impacted.

Julian — if you can flag the 3 deals that have progressed to opportunity or closed, that will speed the manual credit process.

I’ll aim to get a reconciliation plan by tomorrow morning PT. If a short sync is needed, propose Wed 10–10:30 PT.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Julian Park <julian@cyclist.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:12:03 -0800
Subject: Re: Post‑summit numbers — missing demo-scheduler leads

On Mon, Jan 18, 2027 at 3:05 PM Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Laura — can you pull the raw export we sent to Cyclist and compare the HubSpot IDs Julian attached vs the event report we generated (I’ve asked ops to attach it when they reply)?

Thanks — I pulled the event export and matched against Julian’s flagged rows. I’m attaching the report we originally exported: redwood_event_report_jan12.csv. Summary of findings below (high level):

- Of the 28 demo conversions Julian listed, 9 were created by the demo scheduler and had source set to "direct" because the scheduler redirects to a calendar widget that bypasses the event form UTM capture.
- Our MQL rule: (lead_score >= 75) OR (form_type IN ["event-form", "demo-scheduler"]). Due to a recent platform mapping change the demo-scheduler form_type landed as "meeting" for some submissions, so the form_type check failed and those leads did not auto-promote to MQL.
- 3 of the nine flagged contacts have associated opportunities in HubSpot; two are in negotiation (both with ACV > $40k) and one just closed-won yesterday.

Proposed next steps:
1) Backfill form_type=demo-scheduler for the nine contacts (run a CSV update using HubSpot IDs).
2) Re-evaluate lead_score and force-promote the three contacts with opportunities.
3) Regenerate the event rollup and send updated pipeline numbers to Cyclist.
4) Add a mapping rule so the calendar widget maps to demo-scheduler in future exports.

I can run steps 1–2 today and have an updated rollup by EOD tomorrow once we validate the backfill.

Laura Bennett
Marketing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood_event_report_jan12.csv (csv, 28KB)
From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Julian Park <julian@cyclist.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 11:40:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Post‑summit numbers — missing demo-scheduler leads

Thanks Laura — appreciate the clear detective work. Quick note from the AE side: three opportunities that should be credited to the summit are (HubSpot deal ids included):

- D-2027-00452 — CyclistAI — demo booked Jan 12 — currently in Negotiation (expected close Q1)
- D-2027-00457 — CyclistAI — demo booked Jan 13 — Qualified to Stage (POC underway)
- D-2027-00461 — CyclistAI — Closed Won Jan 20

For the closed-won deal (D-2027-00461) we need a retro credit in the event pipeline and a note in the sponsorship ROI line item so Cyclist can claim the conversion for their internal reporting. I’ve attached a short note with the deal timeline and meeting traces. If Ops needs me to confirm any activity traces in HubSpot I can jump on a quick screen share.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 09:07:08 -0800
Subject: Re: Post‑summit numbers — missing demo-scheduler leads

Julian — thanks for the patience; quick summary and next steps: 

1) Root cause: mapping bug sent some demo-scheduler submissions with form_type="meeting" and source="direct". That prevented the backstop logic from flagging those leads as event-sourced MQLs.
2) Actions completed / in flight:
   - Laura backfilled form_type=demo-scheduler for the 9 flagged contacts (done).
   - Ops forced promotion for the 3 contacts with active opportunities (done).
   - We will regenerate the event rollup and produce an updated pipeline report by EOD Fri Jan 22.
   - Manual credit: we will retro-credit D-2027-00452 and D-2027-00457 to the Jan 12 event. D-2027-00461 (Closed Won) will be reflected on the sponsorship ROI statement delivered to Cyclist.
3) Preventative: engineering will add a mapping rule to ensure the calendar widget maps to demo-scheduler going forward; Marissa will own the post-deploy validation.

Please review and confirm if that approach addresses Cyclist’s needs. If yes, I’ll share the updated rollup and a one-page ROI memo for your sponsorship packet when the numbers are regenerated. If you want a brief sync, Wed 10–10:30 PT still works on our side.

Thanks again — we’ll get this wrapped.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
